angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 168,359 km at 23.02 pc = 0.1 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 43.4400 +/- 0.0160 mas (same row, RUWE 1.28): 23.02 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.242 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Barkaoui et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6008 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract): 168,359 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.23 +/- 0.011 solar masses from Barkaoui et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6008 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3075 +/- 75 K from Barkaoui et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6008 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Barkaoui et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6008 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-6008.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 5.032, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6008 (pscomppars): spectral type M5.0, from Barkaoui et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, LSPM J2041+4938: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star

luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6008 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -2.32873, from Barkaoui et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6008 (pscomppars): age 3 Gyr, from Barkaoui et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract)
